cohort: Sixteen development audience recordings; no soundboard/clean reference

config.normalization: For each block, octave-band summed power divided by total FFT power over all bins/channels; dB. Median blocks per recording, then equal-weight cohort median and quartiles.
config.passage_rule: Start at 50% of full decoded source duration, take next 20 seconds; no content search.
config.interpretation: Cohort is varied audience audio, not a clean or soundboard reference. No denoiser, dereverberator, gap repair, source separation or generated identity.
